text:
This is a remote position.
 As a Motion Graphics Designer at RVP Consultants , you do more than just bring graphics to life. You use your strong creative background to create powerful stories and high-quality video content that delivers our message, piques the audience's interest, and reflects our branding priorities. As part of our marketing and creative team, you will create video content and assets for use across a wide variety of media, including social media, mobile platforms, and emerging media.
 Duties Include But Are Not Limited To

• Creating a wide range of visually appealing motion graphics and animation for campaigns, social media, and product UI overviews

• Utilizing video software, such as Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar software, to design and execute captivating motion graphic projects

• Develop creative, strategic ideas that solve specific marketing challenges.

• Take the initial concept to the next level with motion graphics and animations, including 2D and 3D animations.

• incorporating typography, visual effects, and sound design to enhance the overall impact and engagement of motion graphic content.

• Create graphic templates for easy use by other team members.

• Adhere to brand guidelines in ways that still push creative boundaries.

• Staying updated with industry trends and best practices, continuously refining skills, and exploring new techniques to push the boundaries of motion graphics design.

 Requirements

 Basic Qualifications 

• Three (3) or more years of graphic design experience, including motion graphics and animation

• Bachelor’s degree in Design, Fine Arts, Motion Graphics, or another related field OR six (6) or more years of graphic design experience, including motion graphics and animation, with a high school diploma or equivalent required

 Other Qualifications

• Strong technical skills and proven ability to use a variety of software (After Effects, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, Photoshop, and 2D/3D animation software)

• A keen eye for aesthetics and attention to detail ensures high-quality motion graphic deliverables that meet client requirements and exceed expectations.

• A portfolio that showcases aesthetic awareness and design problem-solving abilities

• Having good communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with team members and clients and being able to clearly articulate your ideas.

• Knowledge of various social media platforms and how to use video to engage with different audiences.

 Other Details

 ●Must be located in India

 ●Willing to work EST hours

 RVP Consultants is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, and disability status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.
